hydraulic_graph.simulation: WNTR EPANET baseline simulation from CTOWN.INP
hydraulic_graph.orientation: predominant nonzero signed flow; equipment orientation for zero-flow links
hydraulic_graph.candidate_score_normalization: separate max normalization of PPR and direct component SHAP mass, then equal-weight fusion

evidence_selection: Peak normalized-residual H=12 window whose target timestamp falls within each attack interval.

methods.baseline_a_raw_deviation: Rank sensors by final-horizon instrument-normalized squared residual; map to directly sensed components.
methods.baseline_b_top1_shap: Rank sensors by real SHAP permutation attribution; map the top sensor directly to its component.
methods.proposed_shap_reversed_flow_ppr: Average absolute sensor SHAP magnitudes over the three highest-score event windows, then personalize PageRank on the reversed simulated-flow graph.
